name: grafana-react-sdk-poc-root
description: Disposable private research workspace for the Grafana native-rendering POC.

scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @grafana-react-sdk/poc-host typecheck && yarn workspace @grafana-react-sdk/poc-compat typecheck && yarn workspace @grafana-react-sdk/poc-grafana-bridge typecheck && tsc6 --project tests/e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:poc: tsc6 -b tsconfig.base.json --pretty false && yarn workspace @grafana-react-sdk/poc-host build:app
scripts.inspect:bundle: yarn build:poc && node --eval 'const fs = require("node:fs"); const root = "apps/poc-host/dist/evidence"; const boundary = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${root}/forbidden-import-report.json`, "utf8")); const bundle = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${root}/bundle-evidence.json`, "utf8")); if (boundary.violations.length) { console.error(JSON.stringify(boundary.violations, null, 2)); process.exit(1); } const forbidden = [...bundle.categories.grafanaApplication, ...bundle.categories.grafanaInternal, ...bundle.categories.systemJs]; if (forbidden.length) { console.error(`Forbidden bundle modules:\n${forbidden.join("\n")}`); process.exit(1); } console.log(`Dependency graph clean: ${boundary.inspectedModuleIds.length} imports inspected; ${bundle.moduleIds.length} modules bundled; ${bundle.chunks.length} chunks emitted.`);'
